title: Unicorn Meadow
description: A unicorn farm for kids. Plant carrots, strawberries, corn and pumpkins, water the garden and harvest food to feed your unicorns. Wash them in the bubble shower, paint them with rainbow colors and stamps, brush, style their manes and outfits, build the meadow and adopt new foals.
controls: Tap a unicorn to care for it. Tap a garden bed to plant or harvest, and use the 💧 watering can on the beds. Tap stars to collect them. 🔨 builds and moves things, 🦄 adopts a foal. In care, rub the unicorn to pet, paint, brush or shower it.
requirements: Any modern browser. Saves the farm in this browser.
